report_name: Ahold Delhaize Confirms Cyberattack Caused Widespread Outages

attack_patterns.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
attack_patterns.description: The cyberattack was described as characteristic of a ransomware incident, involving a significant IT disruption consistent with the encryption of servers to cause widespread outages of e-commerce and delivery services.

attack_patterns.name: Endpoint Denial of Service
attack_patterns.description: The cyberattack resulted in a massive IT disruption that took websites and mobile apps offline for Ahold Delhaize's brands, crippling e-commerce and delivery services for over a week.

campaigns.name: Ahold Delhaize October 2026 Cyberattack
campaigns.description: A malicious cyberattack in October 2026 that caused widespread system outages for Ahold Delhaize's grocery brands in the US and Europe, crippling e-commerce operations.

identities.name: Ahold Delhaize
identities.description: Dutch multinational retail group and parent company of Stop & Shop, Food Lion, and Albert Heijn, which suffered a major cyberattack crippling its e-commerce and delivery services.

identities.name: Stop & Shop
identities.description: A U.S. grocery brand owned by Ahold Delhaize whose website and mobile app were taken offline by the cyberattack.

identities.name: Food Lion
identities.description: A U.S. grocery brand owned by Ahold Delhaize whose website and mobile app were taken offline by the cyberattack.

identities.name: Albert Heijn
identities.description: The largest supermarket chain in the Netherlands, owned by Ahold Delhaize, whose website, mobile app, and delivery services were halted by the cyberattack.

indicators.name: Potential Ransomware File Creation (.L0CKED)
indicators.pattern:
title: Potential Ransomware Note Creation (.L0CKED)
id: 0a9b3c1d-e2f3-4a5b-8c6d-7e8f9a0b1c2d
status: experimental
description: Detects the creation of files with the .L0CKED extension, which is indicative of some ransomware families creating ransom notes or encrypted files. This pattern was suggested as a hunting hint in the context of the Ahold Delhaize retail sector attack.
references:
  - https://therecord.media/ahold-delhaize-cyberattack-grocery
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-20
tags:
  - attack.t1486
level: high
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|endswith: '.L0CKED'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the creation of files with the .L0CKED extension, a pattern associated with some ransomware strains. This was provided as a hunting hint for threats targeting retail organizations.
